maria (CS): Quick weekly health snapshot for AstraThera — focusing on tail (p95/p99) by route + model, streaming vs non-streaming. TL;DR: /summarize streaming tail is higher this week, looks tied to long sequences and a spike in streaming usage. Details below.

metrics-bot: Automated snapshot for period 2024-06-11 -> 2024-06-17:
- /summarize — model=rwd-13b-quant 
  - streaming: p95=`450ms`, p99=`910ms`, err=0.42%
  - non-streaming: p95=`320ms`, p99=`630ms`, err=0.15%
- /chat — model=rwd-7b 
  - streaming: p95=`120ms`, p99=`260ms`, err=0.08%
  - non-streaming: p95=`130ms`, p99=`270ms`, err=0.09%
- /rerank — model=rwd-1.3b-rank 
  - streaming: p95=`210ms`, p99=`480ms`
  - non-streaming: p95=`200ms`, p99=`460ms`
Overall account spend this week: `$4.1k` (+18% WoW). Streaming requests = 61% of tokens.

maria (CS): Note the /summarize p99 delta ~+280ms streaming vs non-streaming. Error spike concentrated on streaming path for that route.

sam (Eng): tagging @olivia and @jake — initial hunch: long prefix + frequent KV cache misses on the 13b quant variant. Streaming keeps more KV thrash under high concurrency. Also check batching config (current batch_target=8).

jake (CE): Can we get p95/p99 broken down by input length buckets? If >2k tokens are dominating tail that's expected. Also want GPU util + queue length for the streaming worker pool.

metrics-bot: p99 by token-bucket for /summarize streaming:
- <=512 tokens: p99=`380ms`
- 513-2048 tokens: p99=`720ms`
- >2048 tokens: p99=`1.6s` (samples small but high variance)
Queue backlog observed on pool-aston-13b between 17:30-19:00 UTC (avg queue=14).

sam (Eng): Ok that aligns. Proposal: enable prefix caching for the common 1st-512 tokens, increase batch_target to 16 for the streaming pool, and experiment with soft-evict threshold for KV to avoid thrash. I can roll a canary tomorrow.

olivia (SE): Also recommend a temporary client-side mitigation: set a soft max_tokens hint to 2k for /summarize and add `fallback_model=rwd-7b-stream` for very long sessions. That should reduce 13b tail while we tune server side.

maria (CS): (typo fix) — Maria: I'll draft an email to AstraThera PM to request a short call + ask them to try the 2k soft cap for next 48h.

jake (CE): If we can get GPU traces during the canary window I can validate if kernel stalls or memory pressure are the culprits. Recommend 30-min canary with `batch_target=16` and prefix caching on rwd-13b-quant streaming pool.

sam (Eng): I'll schedule the canary for Tue 09:30 UTC. Will push config behind rollout flag and monitor p99 by token-bucket.

maria (CS): Action items: 1) Sam — deploy canary Tue 09:30 UTC (batch_target=16, prefix cache on). 2) Jake — capture GPU traces during canary. 3) Olivia — send fallback config for client-side soft cap to CS docs. 4) Maria — coordinate AstraThera PM sync and send proposed mitigations.

maria (CS): Any objections? Otherwise I’ll follow up with calendar invite + canary playbook. :thumbsup:

olivia (SE): no objections. :+1:

sam (Eng): all good. :eyes:

jake (CE): sounds good — I'll stand by for traces.

metrics-bot: will post post-canary p95/p99 diff and queue metrics to this thread after run.
